_about: Wyckoff Living NOW. Brand only: colours, faces, art heights. No sizes (P1). v2 = v1 + EV colours (EV review v0.1; EV-7 option B: ink on the gold chip). v3 = v2 repointed to ix/email-tokens-v3.json. No WLN value changed. v4 = v3 + TXA (TXA review v0.1). txa-visit-rule is #ff4400 (TXA-13); highlight stays #cc5500, which the EV eyebrow reads at 8.5px. v8 = v7 repointed to ix/email-tokens-v8.json. No WLN value changed. v9 = v8 repointed to ix/email-tokens-v9.json, plus the Email Pass: page-bg is the pale teal of the web page sides (was @ink-deep); highlight is the salmon web uses (#EC7259, was #cc5500), with highlight-ink #A5503E for small text and the flag; ad-border is Main at 18% on white; the Spotlights band takes ink text. v10 = v9 repointed to ix/email-tokens-v10.json, plus the house-ad pictures (Uploadcare bare bases, made from the web art of WLN-999, 2026-10-03) and Subscribe's edge colour: highlight deepened 22% toward black, as web mixes it (#B85945). v11 = v10 repointed to ix/email-tokens-v11.json. No WLN value changed. v12 = v11 repointed to ix/email-tokens-v12.json. No WLN value changed. v13 = v12 with shorter font fallback chains, to keep the email under Gmail's clip (Email Pass S2): each chain is written into the email about 150 times. Where the web fonts load (Apple Mail, iOS) nothing changes; elsewhere Jost falls back to Avenir then Arial, Playfair and Lora to Georgia, Spectral to Georgia. v14 = v13 repointed to ix/email-tokens-v13.json. No WLN value changed. v15 = v14 repointed to ix/email-tokens-v14.json. No WLN value changed. v16 = v15 repointed to ix/email-tokens-v15.json. No WLN value changed. v17 = v16 repointed to ix/email-tokens-v16.json, plus the end-matter colours that email shell v13 used to type (HC-P-EP2-4): end-bg #cc5500 (advertise hero and footer), end-bar #1a1a0a (dark strips, button words), end-ink #ffffff and end-ink-soft #ffe4d4 (words on those grounds). The gold and soft gold reuse accent and accent-soft. v18 = v17 repointed to ix/email-tokens-v17.json, plus WLN's splash colours (Clean-Up S2, HC-P-CU1-4). splash-bg is WLN's ink (the platform default); the four set here keep the splash exactly as splash v3.4 typed it: gold #C4A35A, words #FAF9F5, ad tile #FDFCF8 with border #D4C9B0. end-bar is removed: no template reads it since email shell v14. v19 = v18 repointed to ix/email-tokens-v18.json (the splash times). No WLN value changed.
